tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have experience in providing a minimum of twelve (12) vehicles on a monthly rental basis to Government Departments, Semi-Government Organizations, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), Urban Local Bodies, Autonomous Bodies, or other public institutions during the last three financial years (2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25).
The bidder shall have an average annual turnover of not less than Rs. 50.00 Lakhs from vehicle rental/transportation services during the last three (2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25) financial years.
